cat siegard.json; find work spec app -type f | head -50; git status --short; git log --oneline | head — exit 0
python3 /tmp/rs/p/s04.plugin/bin/door.py --check review-change --project /tmp/rs/p/s04 --task task/fees/compute-late-fee — exit 1
python3 /tmp/rs/p/s04.plugin/bin/door.py --check implement-task --project /tmp/rs/p/s04 --task task/fees/compute-late-fee — exit 0
python3 /tmp/rs/p/s04.plugin/bin/handoff.py --prepare --skill plan-work --project /tmp/rs/p/s04 --slug lending --target app --language pt-BR — exit 0
cat /tmp/rs/p/s04.plugin/schemas/handoff.json | python3 -c (pretty-print first 9000 chars) — exit 0
